sentences.text: The learned Public Prosecutor, upon instructions submitted that pursuant to Ext.P2 complaint, a crime has been registered as FIR No.375 of 2024 of Infopark Police Station alleging offence under Sections 498A, 323 and 506 r/w Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
In view of the registration of the crime mentioned above, the grievance projected in this writ petition has been redressed.
Accordingly nothing further survives for consideration in this writ petition and it is closed.

Sd/-
